_doc: The axes a person's body and face vary along, each one or two pinned CC0 MakeHuman hm08 graphical targets (assets/authored/humans/makehuman_hm08/SOURCE-variation.json). tools/human_variation_kit.py turns them into one shared delta kit over the hm08 body (assets/humans/web/hm08_variation_kit.*); renderers/web/js/human-variation.js draws each person's values from a seed of their own id. `spread` is the standard deviation of the seeded value on the axis's -1..1 scale (a draw is clipped to +-`limit`: MakeHuman's own sliders at 1 are caricature). `scope` says who gets an axis: `face` is everyone, including a seated driver whose clothes and seat were fitted to his body; `full` is only a person on foot, whose garments are carried by the same deltas. No axis value, height or age drawn here is a record fact; a person whose face is fitted to a picture carries fixed values in hm08_variation_persons.json instead, graded by that picture. An asset's `face_bias` (T-3434) is added to every draw of a person wearing that body, before any fitted face: the women's bodies lean their drawn faces toward MakeHuman's own feminine proportions and a resting mouth (`rest` axes are never drawn, only biased), and an asset's `one_of_allow` limits which options of a `one_of` axis its seed may pick (the women's heads are oval, round, inverted-triangular or diamond, never square or rectangular) and its `face_draw_scale` damps the seeded face and head outline before the bias (the women's draws at half spread), reconstructed depiction choices, not record facts.

height.basis: A seeded uniform scale of the figure about its feet, sd 3.5 % (about 6 cm on the 1.75 m engineering body), clipped at 7 %. Reconstructed: it spreads the town's adults about the body every figure shares; no measured stature of any resident is asserted.

age.basis: MakeHuman's own macro age model: its old targets stand at age 90 and young at 25, so each year moves the young-to-old blend by 1/65. The three upstream shape categories are blended equally, as in the engineering bodies' own recipes; category names are software provenance, not ancestry.

axes.basis: A resting set of the mouth, never drawn: it takes only an asset's face_bias (T-3434), so adding it moves nobody's face.
MakeHuman's face-ageing pair, driven by the person's age (not drawn): +1 at 90, -1 at 25 against the engineering body's 35.
One of MakeHuman's seven head outlines, picked by the seed, at a seeded strength (half-normal, sd 0.45).
The female macro targets, for bodies built on MakeHuman's female macros (T-3423).
MakeHuman's stomach target, used only small and positive, as a paunch.
How far forward the neck carries the head: a posture read in the mesh, since a bone offset would fight the clip each frame.
The engineering bodies' own macro age blend moved by the person's age: old minus young, three upstream categories equally.

The engineering bodies' own macro age blend moved by the person's age: old minus young, three upstream categories equally. The female young and old macros, blended as the female engineering body's own recipe (T-3423).
